name: WattSeal
description: Real-time PC power consumption monitor - see watts per app & per component, track your carbon footprint & electricity cost.

issues.title: Discrepancies with AMD GPUs and ADLX
Triggers my windows defender antivirus whenever I launch it
Bug: Windows Defender blocks execution (VulnerableDriver:WinNT/Winring0) on WinRing0x64.sys

latest_release.name: v1.0.6
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* feat: autostart on windows boot by @CodrinSocol in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/133
* feat: add configurable process list limit by @LivingPixel-pixel in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/135
* build(deps): bump open from 5.4.1 to 5.4.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/140
* feat: add German translation by @LivingPixel-pixel in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/137
* feat: show hardware models in component title tooltips by @LivingPixel-pixel in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/134
* docs: updated README by @CodrinSocol in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/139
* build(deps): bump nvml-wrapper from 0.12.1 to 0.13.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/143
* build(deps): bump open from 5.4.2 to 5.4.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/144
* fix: keep chart controls right-aligned when wrapping by @LivingPixel-pixel in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/145
* Remember the choice when closing WattSeal by @LivingPixel-pixel in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/146
* build(deps): bump open from 5.4.3 to 5.4.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/148
* feat: improve countries and languages by @Daminoup88 in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/152
* build(deps): bump bpaf from 0.9.27 to 0.9.28 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/153
* feat: enhance MQTT integration by @Daminoup88 in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/155

## New Contributors
* @LivingPixel-pixel made their first contribution in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/135

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/compare/v1.0.5...v1.0.6
